main_result.title: The append-oriented exact envelope was compacted without changing the numerical path: V2 removes duplicated raw tuple payload, matched V1 exactly across randomized tests, and reduced local prototype peak memory by 27.2% and build time by 23.0% under tracemalloc.

v2_implementation.change: Immutable runs now keep threshold/per-item value arrays plus suffix aggregates only; raw lower/upper tuple payload from V1 is removed.

main_result.numerical_guard: A more aggressive suffix-difference-only representation saved additional memory but risks floating-point cancellation when reconstructing per-item lconst/sat values during merges. V2 intentionally retains explicit per-item value arrays until compensated reconstruction is separately proved and validated.
main_result.inherited_results: The predecessor checkpoint remains the full record for the initial incremental solver, fail-closed interrupted-block endpoint, informative-size estimand stress, and predictable-weight versus off-policy boundary.

measurement_validity_rules: Do not trade numerical traceability for memory savings without a separate error bound and pathwise revalidation.
V2 is still a computational refactor of the same exact water-filling denominator and predictable-weight statistical contract.
Local tracemalloc/build-time ratios are prototype measurements, not deployment predictions.
scope_guards: No forbidden semantic inputs were read.
The public LSM literature supports only the sorted-run merge architecture, not the statistical validity claim.

frontier.action: Reduce endpoint query cost without changing the denominator: add a direct event/root lookup or safe warm-start/cache, retain residual fail-closed checks, and compare against V2 pathwise.
Implement the fail-closed planned-slot interruption monitor with durable pre-admission and recovery-after-deadline semantics.
Implement the matched OPE-versus-predictable-weight synthetic comparison only where targets are mathematically identical, plus a wrong-target realized-weight counterexample.
Add a simultaneous decision rule for equal-process and planned-exposure channels with explicit joint error budgeting.
Continue public repeated-inference trace search for token-to-score/sign propagation.

frontier.exact_next_action: Prototype a faster exact water-filling root lookup over the live immutable runs, or a provably safe warm-start bracket, and require pathwise equality/residual validation before replacing the V2 bisection query.
